summary: A humorous feature on adult recreational sports leagues, following 'Weekend Warriors' through the fall 2023 season across football, volleyball, basketball, soccer, kickball, softball, flag football and dodgeball. It highlights camaraderie, friendly rivalry, post-game socials, Monday-morning soreness and tall tales, before closing with the winter hiatus and the return of leagues in spring.
one_line: A lighthearted portrait of adult rec league players and their fall 2023 season of rivalry, camaraderie, injuries and exaggerated glory.
key_facts: On September 3, 2023, Steve "The Cannon" Harrison, an insurance salesman, warmed up at Greenville Park; his wife Anna teases him about his tales of 40-yard passes.
Captain Sarah Jennings signed up for the volleyball team 'Volley Llamas' on September 7, 2023, hoping to relive her varsity glory days.
Raj Patel, an accountant, has played basketball every Friday night at the Downtown Community Center since September 15, 2023, and his knees ache come Monday.
Louisa Gomez played in a soccer league game on September 22, 2023, where the ref missed a handball that led to the opposing team's goal, prompting her to swear.
The kickball championship is set for October 8, 2023, with Jerry "The Grand-Slam" Mendoza's team 'Pitch, Please' facing the 'Ballbarians'.
The prize in the kickball championship is bragging rights and a comically oversized trophy that Jerry Mendoza's wife warned must not go on the mantel.
On October 14, 2023, the softball team 'The Tipsy Turtles' performed an impromptu musical reenactment of their double-header sweep for diners.
Sports therapists and chiropractors see a reliable uptick in appointments every Monday morning after game days.
On October 21, 2023, Diane "The Dynamo" Fitzpatrick visited her chiropractor limping after scoring the game-winning goal.
On Halloween Weekend 2023, the adult flag football league held its annual costume tradition; Bob "The Bruiser" Branson, dressed as a giant taco, made a game-saving tackle and gained meme fame.
Cindy "Cyclone" Liu, a dodgeball player, took a tumble on November 11, 2023, and worried about fitting her crutches into next week's costume theme.
Outdoor leagues pause in winter and resume with the first spring leagues.
